name: Bounded-Memory Large Volume Export
definition: Processes large volumes (OME-Zarr or RAW) with bounded memory by streaming chunks, computing intensity baselines, cropping to disjoint aligned bricks, and writing compressed outputs without loading the full volume.
summary: Bounded-Memory Large Volume Export streams large 3D volumes to enforce a strict memory limit, cropping data to aligned bricks and packing only foreground voxels into a compact file while discarding background values.
